name: QuizHP
description: QuizHP turns any topic into an interactive quiz game. When you ask for a quiz, the AI generates questions and QuizHP renders each one as a unique canvas mini-game — archery targets, treasure chests, piano keys, bomb defusal, and 125+ more templates. Supports multiple-choice and true/false questions. No account or authentication required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add QuizHP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add QuizHP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.quizhp.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the QuizHP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: QuizHP provides these MCP tools: play-quiz.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to QuizHP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to QuizHP in media on the Manufact MCP catalog include CardChain AI, FreqBlog Music Metadata, Futrumi, KinElo, and Wistia.
QuizHP does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
QuizHP is developed by Hunch AI, LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
